## Attestation

## Checks

- [ ] Lint and format pass locally for every stack touched (Kotlin `ktlintCheck detekt`, Java `spotlessCheck`, Swift `swiftformat --lint` + `swiftlint`, JS/TS `lint` + `typecheck` + `format:check`)
- [ ] Unit tests pass for touched modules
- [ ] Bug fix? A test fails without this change
- [ ] No new dependency, or the dependency gate is satisfied and Platform approved
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or real customer data in the diff or in fixtures
